topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: Orbital configurations with high satellite velocities, frequent line-of-sight obstructions, and requirements for reliable, high-data-rate communication justify prioritizing V-band. Its lower frequency reduces Doppler effects and atmospheric interference, while advanced beamforming techniques enhance signal quality. Adaptive modulation mitigates phase noise and oscillator instability.
reference_context: Optical communications are impaired by atmospheric phenomena, but offer high throughput with fewer gateways, whereas RF systems like V-band are less affected but require more gateways.
